summary: Implemented the LLM bridge vertical slice across the local bridge service, FastAPI proxy, AppForge driver/readiness path, Vue provider settings UI, backend tests, frontend build assets, and dependency lock repair.
features_completed: Local Bun/TypeScript llm_bridge service with provider registry, config persistence, active selection, provider test, generate, and stream endpoints.
Bridge regression test proving provider upsert responses do not echo stored API keys.
Python appforge.llm_bridge HTTP client for bridge health, provider management, active selection, tests, and generation.
FastAPI /api/llm same-origin provider proxy with structured LLM_BRIDGE_ERROR handling.
LLMBridgeDriver and driver aliases llm-bridge, llm_bridge, and llm in create_driver.
JobManager health readiness that refuses false-ready llm-bridge state unless the active provider is known and configured.
Vue TopBar LLM connection control and ProviderSettings modal for provider save/delete/test/activate flows.
Frontend API/type extensions and responsive settings styles.
Backend tests for readiness and provider proxy delegation.
Regenerated packaged frontend assets under appforge/resources/web.
Frontend lockfile registry/integrity repair plus .npmrc replace-registry-host=always.
Python dev extra includes setuptools and wheel so the no-isolation package build gate has the declared build backend available.
decisions: Keep bridge provider secrets in the local bridge config/environment and expose only has_key/key_source/status metadata to the browser; provider upsert no longer returns the raw saved config.
Use the FastAPI server as the same-origin proxy boundary instead of letting the browser call the bridge directly.
Make configured active provider status part of readiness instead of treating bridge reachability as sufficient.
Keep bridge generation single-shot per AppForge stage attempt and rely on AppForge checkpoints for reruns.
Avoid adding a direct frontend dependency on @vue/shared; it remains only a Vue transitive dependency.
Keep llm_bridge as a separate local process rather than broadening this slice into launcher orchestration.
Add setuptools and wheel to the dev extra because AppForge's root build gate runs python -m build --no-isolation inside the synced local environment.
known_gaps: Live third-party provider calls require user-supplied credentials and were not automated.
Bridge startup remains separate from the FastAPI web server in this slice.
AppForge detect_stack only detects the root Python/FastAPI app; frontend and bridge checks are recorded explicitly in verification.
